description: This file defines a class 'Upgrade' that provides methods for database schema and data manipulation such as adding records, retrieving records, checking for the existence of tables and fields, and dropping tables and fields. It is part of the upgrade process in the OpenCart installation system.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: Provides database upgrade and schema manipulation methods within the OpenCart installation process.

methods.name: addRecord
methods.description: Inserts a record into a specified table with provided data, returning the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all records from a specified table.

methods.name: hasTable
methods.description: Checks whether a specified table exists in the database.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks whether a specified field exists in a given table.

methods.name: dropTable
methods.description: Drops a specified table if it exists.

methods.name: dropField
methods.description: Drops a specified field from a table if it exists.
